kinds.name: panel_tab
kinds.doc:
A kind of tab.

`describe` answers the same on every call with nothing run. `tail` is asked only of a [`Shows::Log`] kind.

slots.name: describe
slots.doc: What this kind of tab is.

slots.name: tail
slots.doc: The latest lines of the log, oldest first, each ended by a newline; empty for a kind that shows no log.
